en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a compact European alpine town nestled on a hillside, backed by high, barren mountains. The town is dominated by several church buildings: one large Gothic-style church with a very tall, slender spire on a hill above the town, another with a bulbous Baroque onion dome near the center, and a smaller chapel-like church with an arched entrance in the foreground. Traditional multi‑story houses with steep roofs cluster tightly along narrow streets. Fields, trees, and haystacks appear in the foreground, and forested slopes rise behind the settlement.
